SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl,
 min(sale_date), max(sale_date), sum(net_amount) AS net, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) AS staff_net,
 count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at),
 sum(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS date_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21') AS stg_n
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'

WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'),
d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM p GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT p.sale_date, p.etl_loaded_at, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT p.receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(p.net_amount) AS net, min(p.sales_line_id), max(p.sales_line_id),
 (SELECT count(*) FROM p p2 WHERE p2.sale_date=p.sale_date) AS day_lines
FROM p JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sl AS (
  SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) AS rn FROM fact_sales_line f),
sd AS (SELECT sl.*, s.store_id FROM sl JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE rn=1 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND s.store_id<900),
rt AS (
  SELECT r.*, s.store_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.sales_line_id, r.return_date, r.quantity_returned, r.refund_net ORDER BY r.return_line_id) AS rn2
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND s.store_id<900),
a AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_amount) AS gross_dedup, count(*) AS n FROM sd GROUP BY 1),
a2 AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS gross_raw FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT store_id, sum(refund_net) AS ret_raw, sum(CASE WHEN rn2=1 THEN refund_net END) AS ret_dedup, count(*) AS rn_, sum(CASE WHEN rn2>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dupr FROM rt GROUP BY 1),
c AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_gross, sum(returns_net) AS rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) AS rpt_net, count(*) AS days FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.store_id, a.n, a2.gross_raw, a.gross_dedup, c.rpt_gross, b.ret_raw, b.ret_dedup, b.dupr, c.rpt_ret, c.rpt_net, c.days
FROM a LEFT JOIN a2 USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN b USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN c USING (store_id) ORDER BY a.store_id

WITH per AS (
  SELECT period_start_date AS d0, period_end_date AS d1 FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 5
),
sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS gross_net
  FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) AS rn FROM fact_sales_line) f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key, per
  WHERE f.rn = 1 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1 AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY s.store_id
),
rets AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key, per
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1 AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY s.store_id
)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sales.gross_net - coalesce(rets.refunds, 0) DESC) AS rank,
       cur.store_id, cur.store_name,
       round(sales.gross_net - coalesce(rets.refunds, 0), 2) AS net_sales
FROM sales LEFT JOIN rets USING (store_id)
JOIN dim_store cur ON cur.store_id = sales.store_id AND cur.is_current
ORDER BY rank, cur.store_id
